method: Managed Chromium runtime plus current-source inspection

tests.evidence: 12 sequential Tab advances were captured from the rendered authenticated portal.
The captured sequence remained inside the active development dialog and followed its logical controls.
Focused controls exposed a computed 3px outline and supplementary focus shadow.
The named Development preview controls dialog opened and closed through its supported controls.
The AI Guide sheet rendered with the accessible dialog name AI Guide.
Both the dialog and AI Guide sheet closed on Escape in managed Chromium.
Every visible focusable sign-in form control had an accessible label; the unlabelled primitive reported in raw output was non-focusable implementation markup.
Role=alert error containers and validation assertions are present; no real authentication was submitted.
The managed browser API does not expose a reliable browser-zoom control.
Sign-in and authenticated home were inspected at 390×844.
Full image/glass contrast certification requires dedicated visual contrast tooling.

The pre-fix runtime scan found compact controls; authenticated portal targets were enlarged in portal-v13.css, but exact post-fix browser recapture was blocked when the shared preview changed project identity. Sign-in CSS was not changed after its accepted no-scroll measurement.
Runtime components and CSS include prefers-reduced-motion guards; media emulation was unavailable.

Focusable controls were named; a chart SVG exposed no name in the pre-fix scan and current source disables that duplicate focus target in favor of the labelled chart group and accessible data table. Post-fix AT recapture was blocked by shared-preview identity drift.

certification: No WCAG or assistive-technology certification is claimed.
